task: Write a single Python function using boto3 that lists all S3 bucket names in an AWS account whose names start with a given prefix.
Write a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a single S3 bucket named 'example-logs-bucket'.
Write a single regex that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs, which begin with 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
